$comment: Public Firebase web client identifiers for the production "burnbar" project, read by website/src/lib/firebaseClient.ts and apps/console/lib/firebaseClient.ts. Not secrets: every browser bundle ships them, and access is enforced by App Check, Firestore/Storage rules and the API key's restrictions. This file is the one place to rotate them; PUBLIC_* / NEXT_PUBLIC_* env overrides them for staging and preview builds.
